# Plotmark Real Estate

> Plotmark Real Estate L.L.C (brand: plotmark.) is a data-driven real estate brokerage in Dubai, United Arab Emirates: every recommendation is backed by official Dubai Land Department sales and rent data. It helps clients buy off-plan property, buy ready (completed) apartments, townhouses and villas, rent homes, and sell or let property they own. It works with a select number of clients at a time, each with one dedicated advisor from first enquiry to handover.

## Key facts
- Legal name: Plotmark Real Estate L.L.C
- Type: data-driven boutique real estate brokerage
- Office: BurJuman Centre, Al Mankhool, Dubai, UAE (address on the trade licence)
- Licence: Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism (DET) commercial licence No. 1663768
- Website: https://plotmark.ae
- Contact: enquiries@plotmark.ae (enquiry form on the website)
- Services: off-plan property brokerage; ready property sales; residential rentals and leasing (tenancy contracts and Ejari); selling and letting for owners; buying and selling property in Egypt through partners
- Communities covered in Dubai: Dubai Marina, Palm Jumeirah, Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Dubai Hills Estate, Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, Dubai Creek Harbour, Dubai South
- Egypt areas: New Cairo, New Administrative Capital, Sheikh Zayed City, North Coast

## Approach
- Data, not opinion: advice based on registered DLD sales and Ejari rents, not asking prices
- Opportunities flagged on the numbers: below-median prices, rental yields, off-plan entry points
- A deal sheet for each option: price per sq ft vs area, total cost incl. 4% DLD fee, expected rent and gross yield
- Boutique: fewer clients, closer attention
- One point of contact from first call to keys
- Considered shortlists rather than every listing on the market
- Prices, payment plans, service charges and fees set out plainly
- Offers, contracts, NOC, Ejari and transfer coordinated for the client

## Pages
- [Home](https://plotmark.ae/): services, communities, how it works, FAQ and enquiry form
- [Dubai mortgage calculator](https://plotmark.ae/mortgages/): monthly payment, maximum loan under UAE Central Bank limits (80% first home up to AED 5M for expatriates, 70% above; 50% off-plan; 50% debt burden ratio; 25-year maximum term), and upfront costs (4% DLD transfer fee, 0.25% + AED 290 mortgage registration, trustee fee). Plotmark is a real estate brokerage, not a mortgage broker.
- [Property valuation](https://plotmark.ae/valuation/): instant estimate of a Dubai home's value from registered DLD sales of similar homes (area, type, bedrooms, size, ready or off-plan), with typical rent and gross yield; refreshed weekly. Indicative, not a formal valuation.
- [Dubai market trends](https://plotmark.ae/market/): sales volumes, off-plan share, price per sq ft and rents by community, refreshed weekly from Dubai Land Department open data
- [Insights](https://plotmark.ae/insights/): Dubai property guides
  - [Off-plan vs ready property in Dubai: which suits you?](https://plotmark.ae/insights/off-plan-vs-ready-property-dubai/): How buying off-plan and buying ready compare on price, payment, risk, financing and timing, and the questions to ask before you choose.
  - [The full cost of buying property in Dubai (2026)](https://plotmark.ae/insights/cost-of-buying-property-dubai/): Beyond the price: the Dubai Land Department fee, trustee and title deed charges, mortgage costs and other fees, with a worked example.
  - [Renting a home in Dubai: a step-by-step guide](https://plotmark.ae/insights/renting-a-home-in-dubai/): From setting a budget to Ejari and moving in, plus the rules on rent increases that every tenant should know.
  - [Dubai mortgage rules explained: how much can you borrow?](https://plotmark.ae/insights/dubai-mortgage-rules-explained/): Loan-to-value limits, the 50% debt burden ratio, maximum terms and what banks look at, in plain English.
